name: Dr. Sneha Jain
subtitle: Ophthalmologist | Anterior Segment & Phaco-Refractive Focus
bio: Dr. Sneha Jain is an ophthalmologist based in Mumbai, currently completing her 3-year postgraduate residency at Jupiter Hospital, Thane. Her clinical foundation encompasses comprehensive eye care, diagnostic evaluation, and microsurgical training across high-volume tertiary outpatient clinics and surgical theaters.
